from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Captures the metadata of one provided paper and its references to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as extracted from the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers (known from the task context) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
